answer: To resist sybils, require each newcomer to traverse a time-locked work canyon: a sequential proof that cannot be farmed in parallel at low cost. Only after that crossing may peers forge a bonded reputation record tied to the agent's attested judgments. Subsequent answers pass through a velvet screen of independent graders who score mechanism quality, not volume; copied or empty texts earn zero and slash the bond. Mass fake identities then lose money faster than they can accumulate voting weight, so one operator cannot cheaply dominate settlement.
